landmarks.innerText: CLOVER FOR RESTAURANTS You bring the flavor, Clover powers the pay Improve efficiencies, reduce costs, and do what you do better with a Clover restaurant pos system. Get started with Clover Explore POS offerings for your business Contact sales Connect with a sales team professional Manage it all from one system built for restaurants Take and modify orders Fire orders to the kitchen Accept payments Map your tables Speed up service Create menu categories Everything your restaurant needs in one place FRONT OF HOUSE From the restaurant floor… Control coursing, menu modifications, seating, and more with ordering and payment solutions at the counter or tableside. BACK OF HOUSE To the kitchen… Connect the front of house to the back to maintain smooth, efficient service with timed order routing, inventory tracking, and real-time order display. BACK OFFICE And everything in‑between Boost operational efficiencies, optimize team performance, manage finances, and more—all from a single dashboard designed for restaurant owners and operators. Online ordering made easy with eCommerce solutions Boost revenue and expand your offerings with commission-free online ordering, delivery management, and seamless integration with third-party delivery apps. Online ordering Learn more about online ordering chevron_left chevron_right Meet the future of restaurant ordering In quick service restaurants, improving efficiency is a key ingredient. The Clover Kiosk promotes faster service by letting customers place their own orders. Grow your average ticket value Kiosks give customers more freedom and flexibility to browse and customize, leading to higher order values, in addition to cross selling and upselling options within the kiosk software. Streamline operations Front-of-house tasks no longer need as much attention, saving money on labor costs. Integrated workflow Menus are automatically imported and synced across all devices. Easily add pick-up and dine in orders, all while ensuring accuracy and reducing food wastage. Customize your restaurant tools Flex Pocket This mobile POS is built with a user-friendly interface, robust operations tools, full-day battery life, and digital receipts. Flex Discover the Flex handheld POS system Take orders tableside or payments on the go with our handheld, 100% mobile POS device. KDS Discover the Kitchen Display System Connect front-of-house service, online orders, and kitchen staff with a Kitchen Display System that serves up everything seamlessly. Station Solo Discover the Station Solo POS system The easy-to-use POS that keeps your whole team on the same page from the front of house to the back of the bar. Station Duo Discover the Station Duo POS system With a dual-screen terminal perfect for high-volume counters, you’ll accept payments and make faster customer transactions. Mini Learn more about Mini POS system The small-but-mighty Mini is a compact POS that doesn’t need a lot of counter space to take care of business. Go Discover the Go handheld card reader Turn any smartphone into a totally portable point-of-sale system with the Go card reader and Clover Go App. Kiosk Kiosk Our self-ordering kiosk features a commercial display and payment terminal that gives customers more control over their order. Take your restaurant to the next level with Clover Full‑service restaurant Running a restaurant or bar calls for a tailored, full-service system to keep operations running smoothly. Full‑service restaurants Explore Clover for full-service restaurants Quick‑service restaurant With high-volume service, speed matters. Keep your queue moving with a quick service solution for your cafe, food truck, or coffee cart. Quick‑service restaurants Explore Clover for quick-service restaurants Want to purchase a device with Clover? It’s never been easier. Set up your Clover POS system with the right mix of devices and apps for your business. Add more devices or apps when you’re ready. Contact sales Explore POS offerings for your business
